verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has no documented built-in AI that analyzes an issue and proposes a root cause; its own AI feature only turns natural-language descriptions into search queries. However, its official MCP server lets an external AI assistant pull error data, "analyze patterns, and help investigate production issues," and deploy tracking links revisions to GitHub/GitLab diffs, so root-cause analysis is possible only through a third-party agent. Missing for 10: native in-platform AI root-cause analysis, AI correlation of stack traces, breadcrumbs and related commits, proposed root-cause or fix output, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
